{"label": "attempt-004 · 编译期几何与掩码消除", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "d59c1ca7f3d2a8bd16c9a33bbeecb8b6b0205623174958f83959f0e2da5818fc", "parent_source_sha256": "247091f353b9877d40603d725176b8b1d2418e828d4129da85c413e7f533f524", "qualified": true, "score": 0.1664112309797632, "latency_ms": 0.7748851999999999, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "编译期几何\n消除冗余掩码", "category": "sim", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_compile_time_geometry", "attribution": "Codex修改前读取成对profiling并分析动态元数据；模型修改前独立读取当前模拟器、TTIR和源码，实际成对profiling读取由宿主完成。源码constexpr与元数据整除守卫共同实现几何特化；具体收益和低层变化以完整真机及后重放为准。", "preedit_review": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-004/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-004/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "7389e149620c8c81c6be4a52025104f6fb657e2e50b9c21d6cdcdc165a2acbb5", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第3轮"}

{"label": "attempt-005 · 非因果query行复用", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "23d7322958578d08372dfd9f830f7dc251c4235aa34e7bacf8a3cacdcee90afc", "parent_source_sha256": "d59c1ca7f3d2a8bd16c9a33bbeecb8b6b0205623174958f83959f0e2da5818fc", "qualified": true, "score": 0.27293205177279917, "latency_ms": 0.47246045000000003, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "query行64→128\n减少重复KV读取", "category": "sim", "location": "host", "selected_layer": "triton_host_launch", "attribution": "从已验收编译期几何版的当前双分析出发，模型依据交接等待和低Cube productive选择增加M方向复用。只改非因果BLOCK_M，kernel AST与当前精度路径保持。UB资源、实际程序总量和搬运成本以编译、四项及后重放为准；模型GM→L1预测偏差单独记录。", "preedit_review": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-005/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-005/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "718725e67cb8899038032f60a81706378bacffe9ab221e6df78e81decb1c5bc0", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第4轮"}

{"label": "attempt-006 · 整块KV与单轮特化", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "aec8e907f907a8d647f70a343ba0fd38d3d848636a586276f96084e30930895d", "parent_source_sha256": "fb1233ed36410fed5adc7c210b0a4247f9ebc4ed54461feeffd450ec679003a6", "qualified": true, "score": 0.39260422083576396, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.3284468, "score_is_rebased": false, "method": "单次PV＋整块KV\n去初始重缩放", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_device_and_metadata", "attribution": "从已验收004出发。模型读取当前profiling与实际IR，改选BN256并显式特化恰好一个KV块的路径，消除初始零acc/l重缩放。实际改法与宿主原指定M256分别记录；M256另由007实测。输入未新增前置模拟器报告，宿主保留历史知识，后重放单列。实际修改为Triton源码与metadata，IR用于解释。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-006/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-006/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "5889d36520cf57b9d7246c1c231a3d4809bf3b9661ae4c2744768b6cdbc2d852", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第6轮"}

{"label": "attempt-019 · 持久复用与并行度平衡", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "2a98e3e0c1b1bf631f88c0d613b98d4532bb6273fccf4441291dda87fe749113", "parent_source_sha256": "beeb2335d99a34262701b9023d62b816f7621381eaada3500506d6dde805f9f4", "qualified": true, "score": 0.49165283749765276, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.26227775000000003, "score_is_rebased": false, "method": "每组两个query头\n增加并行程序", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_kernel_and_host_launch", "attribution": "从017把共享KV头拆为2头子组，32→128program、每program16→4tile；GM→L1 52→64MiB。262.27775μs，原四项、后双分析及条件交错计时通过；全调用收益与独立kernel近似分别记录。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-019/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-019/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "541b54f40781247ed7727948be62b666ce3ad36ece7875f4512bf329ae4ccbc5", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第8轮"}
